tasks.title: WAL Protocol - Add to AGENTS.md
tasks.description: Add Write-Ahead Logging section to AGENTS.md

trigger_on: Corrections: 'It's X, not Y', 'Actually...', 'No, I meant...'
Proper nouns: names, places, companies, products
Decisions: 'Let's do X', 'Go with Y', 'Use Z'
Specific values: numbers, dates, IDs, URLs
content.rule: If ANY of these appear: STOP → WRITE to daily notes → THEN respond
content.why: The urge to respond is the enemy. Context will vanish. Write first.

tasks.title: Verify Implementation principle - Add to AGENTS.md
tasks.description: Add one-liner principle about checking mechanism not just text

details.content: **Verify Implementation, Not Intent:** Text changes ≠ behavior changes. When modifying how something works, check the MECHANISM (config values, code paths), not just the text/prompt. Test by observing behavior.

tasks.title: Autonomous vs Prompted Crons - Document pattern
tasks.description: Add cron architecture guidance to AGENTS.md or HEARTBEAT.md

systemEvent.example: Reminder to human, prompt for action

content.rule: If the work should happen WITHOUT main session attention → use isolated agentTurn

principles: Stability > Novelty — don't break working things for shiny
No complexity theater — reject changes that 'look smart' but add no value
Verifiable only — if you can't test it worked, don't do it
Compound leverage — optimize for future-you solving more problems with less cost

details.action: Run checkpoint to IPFS (existing proactive-amcp infrastructure)
why: No duplicate buffer file to manage
Solvr can pin it for free
